question_en: An F-31.04 system shows abnormal response and process variables outside the expected range. Which evidence best supports locating the problem?
options: Measured process variables together with device/component checks and comparison to system specifications.
explanation_en: F-31.04 uses process measurements and component verification to identify probable root cause and location of faults.
explanation_es: F-31.04 usa mediciones del proceso y verificación de componentes para identificar la causa probable y ubicación de fallas.
